_comment: Category blocklist per tier. A preset is only installed if its classified tier
is <= max_tier AND its category is not in the blocklist for max_tier.
Categories dropped at every tier are demo/test/post-effect shaders that are
not useful for retro-gaming (procedural, cut, vhs, etc.).
At T0-T1 (storage-constrained weak GPUs) we additionally drop heavy or
decorative categories (borders, windowed, reshade, motionblur, etc.).
At T4 (full GPU + desktop storage) we install everything the user might want.
